# mergewf_tool_access_block (Resource)

Manages an organization tool block. Changes replace the block; use create_before_destroy to avoid a gap in enforcement. Import using the block ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_tool_access_block" "example" {
  connector  = "github"
  tool_class = "DESTRUCTIVE"
  reason     = "Prevent destructive GitHub operations"
  lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `connector` (String) API field `connector`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 100.
- `reason` (String) API field `reason`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Maximum length: 1000.
- `tool` (String) API field `tool`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 200.
- `tool_class` (String) API field `tool_class`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Allowed values: `READ_ONLY`, `WRITE`, `DESTRUCTIVE`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_tool_access_block.example RESOURCE_ID
```
